{"title": "updatePrefs accepts an unknown time zone, so /v1/me/digest panics", "body": "Fingerprint fp_5b6f14, report cr_94e7b0 (2 panics, v1.4.0, commit 9c41e7a): GET /v1/me/digest?days=14 panics with "unknown time zone Europe/Lisboa" at internal/must.Get, called from api.(*API).digest (api/users.go:81).

Cause: api/users.go updatePrefs copied req.TZ into the user's prefs without checking it. A PUT /v1/me/prefs with a zone name that time.LoadLocation can't load (here "Europe/Lisboa"; the real IANA name is Europe/Lisbon) was stored and returned 200. Each later digest call then ran must.Get(time.LoadLocation(u.Prefs.TZ)), which panics.

Fix: updatePrefs now calls time.LoadLocation on req.TZ and returns 400 "unknown time zone ..." when it fails, so a bad zone is never stored.

Reproducer: api/tz_prefs_test.go TestPrefsRejectsUnknownZone (fails before the fix with status 200, passes after).

Note: prefs already stored with a bad zone by v1.4.0 will still panic in digest. They need a data cleanup. Related: #114 (reminder zone), which is a separate path.", "fingerprint": "fp_5b6f14", "reproducer": {"file": "api/tz_prefs_test.go", "function": "TestPrefsRejectsUnknownZone"}, "root_cause": {"file": "api/users.go", "function": "(*API).updatePrefs"}}
